title: Question 3.3: HashingTF - Converting Words to Numbers
instruction: Computers work with numbers, not words. This code converts words into numerical representations that the computer can process.
reveal: HashingTF (Hashing Term Frequency) converts words into numbers. It counts how many times each word appears and represents this as a vector (a list of numbers). The `.setNumFeatures(10000)` creates space for up to 10,000 different features (word positions). This is like creating a giant spreadsheet where each column represents a possible word, and the numbers show how many times that word appeared in the text.
